method.referenceComparison: Manual check against the public JFK opening phrase; transcript text is not retained.
limits: Native model adapter only; not the browser or Audio Tools product route.
One clean English fixture and one run per model; this is not a percentile, held-out corpus, or accuracy qualification.
Model load time is measured per fresh test engine; memory and cold service startup were not measured.
Kroko commercial/OEM licensing remains unconfirmed; do not use as a commercial default.
The 20M model was not given a full expected-transcript assertion; only its expected final suffix was checked.

models.expectedReferencePrefix: ask not what your country can do for you

decision: Keep the 310 MB Apache-2.0 model as the sherpa-streaming engine default. The 20M candidate improves load/feed compute but has later first text on this fixture. Kroko is substantially smaller and its JFK output passed the tested phrase, but first text is still later than 1 s and the commercial license is unresolved. None of these one-run native measurements changes the 30-run browser p95 result or qualifies a new default.
